introH2: 🏖️ How do Kata and Karon differ, and which part should you stay in?
introHtml: If Patong is Phuket's liveliest beach, Kata and Karon — the next two bays south — are its calmer cousins. They sit side by side on the island's west coast, but each has its own character · Karon Beach is the longest and widest in this area, fine white sand with people spread out and a far mellower feel than Patong — good for families and anyone who just wants to unwind · Kata Beach is smaller and a touch livelier, with a walkable strip of restaurants and shops, plus surf swells in the monsoon months · And tucked behind the next headland is Kata Noi (Little Kata), the smallest and quietest cove of all, where resorts like Katathani and The Shore hold court · The southern tip also has the Karon Viewpoint, where three bays line up in one photo · That range means Kata & Karon has stays from a few hundred baht a night to five figures, each a genuinely different experience — book the wrong zone and the whole mood of your trip changes: you wanted to walk barefoot to the sand but ended up on a hill that needs a buggy, or brought a toddler to an adults-only resort · This guide gathers 10 Kata & Karon hotels we've reviewed in depth, covering every budget — all built from reading real guest reviews, with the good and the honest caveats spelled out, prices compared across 3 booking sites, and direct links to book
mrtHtml: Phuket has no rail transit — you'll get around by rental car, Grab, or hotel transfer · Kata & Karon sit on the island's west coast, about 45 minutes–1 hour from Phuket Airport (HKT) and 20–30 minutes over the hill from Patong · The zones in this guide: On Kata Noi Beach — the smallest, quietest cove, on the sand or a short walk down (Katathani, The Shore) · Karon Beach — the long, wide beach, across the road or a 3–5 minute walk to the sand, near beach restaurants (Sugar Marina ART, Baan Karonburi, Pineapple, The Old Phuket) · Central Kata — walkable to the beach and restaurants (Chanalai Romantica) · Karon Road, between the two beaches — walkable to both Karon and Kata (KK) · Hillside above the beach — sea views from height, quiet, but the slope means a car or buggy (The Shore, The SIS Kata, Andaman Cannacia) · After dark Kata & Karon are far quieter than Patong; if nightlife matters, budget for taxis over the hill

entries.name: The Shore at Katathani
entries.revCount: Score 9.3 · 1,535 reviews · 98 villas, every one with a private pool

rooms.type: Seaview Pool Villa In Love (guaranteed full sea view)

tags: 🌅 Infinity pools with Andaman sea views
entries.addr: 18 Kata Noi Road, Karon, Mueang, Phuket
entries.storyHtml: If your brief is "just the two of us, a sea view, and zero fuss," The Shore at Katathani is the name that comes up again and again for this area — a 5-star adults-only pool-villa resort on the hillside above Kata Noi, the quietest beach in the neighbourhood. All 98 villas have a private pool, many of them infinity pools with the Andaman Sea in view from the bed. It scores 9.3 from 1,535 reviews, the highest in this list · Guests keep saying the place is designed to spend all day inside your villa without feeling you're missing out — a morning swim in your own pool, sunset from the pool edge — plus a sea-view breakfast at The Harbor and access to the facilities of Katathani on the beach below · The honest caveats: the resort paths are steep with plenty of steps and you'll rely on a buggy, peak-season rates run high (value scores 8.4, the lowest of any category), and children under 12 can't stay · Best for honeymooners and couples celebrating something who want a private, quiet villa stay
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you're paying for the view, go all the way — the Seaview Pool Villa In Love is the one that guarantees a full sea view · Mention any special occasion when booking; the team is known for arranging surprises · Book May–October and rates drop nearly by half · And ask for a lower-zone villa near the centre if steep walking is an issue
pros: 9.3 — the highest score in this list · private pool in all 98 villas
Genuinely quiet adults-only mood — honeymoon and anniversary territory
Infinity pools with Andaman sea views from bed · sea-view breakfast at The Harbor
Use the restaurants and facilities of Katathani on the beach below too
cons: Steep paths and lots of steps — you rely on a buggy, and it's slippery after rain

entries.storyHtml: Katathani Phuket Beach Resort is the big sibling that has held almost the entire Kata Noi beachfront since 1984 — a 5-star beachfront resort of about 500 rooms across 3 wings, with 6 pools and the Aqua Jungle water park. It scores 8.6 from 1,799 reviews, the largest review base in this list · It's the same group as The Shore but a different brief: this one is fully family-friendly, you step from your room onto the sand, and the Kata Noi water out front is clearer and less crowded than Phuket's bigger beaches. Reviews praise the beachfront location, the varied breakfast, and the kids' activities · The honest caveats: it's a large resort with older and renovated wings mixed together (the Vhari water-park wing opened in late 2025 and is the newest), and in peak season it's busy, so you'll want to claim a poolside lounger early · Best for families who want a 5-star on the sand with pools and a water park all in one place
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a sea view, step up to a Junior Suite Oceanfront on the beachfront · Travelling with small kids? Ask for a room in the Vhari wing near the Aqua Jungle water park · Grab a poolside lounger early in peak season · And compare all 3 sites, because a big resort's promo rates vary a lot

entries.storyHtml: The SIS Kata Resort is a design boutique created by three sisters (SIS = sisters) on the hillside above Kata Beach, 124 rooms, scoring 8.9 from 456 reviews — among the highest in this list · What reviews talk about most is the sea-view infinity pool facing the sunset, the Stella pool with underwater star lights, and the SIS Over The Sea rooms with a twin jacuzzi on the balcony overlooking the sea, which tend to sell out first in peak season. The whole resort photographs well, at rates starting in the low thousands of baht · The honest caveats: it's on the hillside, a 5–8 minute walk down to Kata Beach but a steep climb back (a shuttle helps), and the entry-level SIS On The Hill rooms have no sea view — if the view is the point, step up to an Over The Sea room · Best for couples and design lovers who want a sea view from the hill at a reachable price
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The twin-jacuzzi, sea-view SIS Over The Sea rooms always sell out first — lock one in early · For a gentler price, choose SIS On The Hill or Over The Stella Pool · Use the resort shuttle for the climb back up · And head to the infinity pool at sunset for the best view

entries.storyHtml: Andaman Cannacia Resort & Spa is a 4-star wellness resort on the hillside above Kata Beach, 115 rooms and villas. Its selling point is a two-tier cascading pool that looks out over the Andaman Sea, plus the Flow Spa and Fitness Cove. It scores 7.7 from 1,103 reviews · Reviews see it as a value pick for a hillside sea-view location, with rates from around ฿1,800 and a roughly 5-minute walk down to Kata Beach; the Canna Deluxe Seaview is the popular choice for anyone who wants the view without stepping up to a villa · The honest caveats worth knowing: the overall 7.7 is the lowest score in this list, some bathrooms are small and some fittings are ageing, and it's a steep climb on the hillside — this is a value-over-newness stay · Best for travellers who prioritise a hillside sea view and a spa on a lighter budget and don't mind older rooms
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For the view, ask for a Canna Deluxe Seaview — better value than stepping up to a villa · Check current room photos and recent reviews before booking, as rooms vary by age · Be ready for the uphill climb · And compare all 3 sites, since promo rates differ clearly

faqTitle: FAQ — what travellers ask most about Kata & Karon hotels in Phuket

faq.q: ❓ What's the best hotel in Kata & Karon?
faq.a: It depends on your style and budget · If you go by score, The Shore at Katathani at 9.3 — adults-only pool villas — is number one in this list · For families, Katathani Phuket Beach Resort is a 5-star on the sand with a water park · For a design boutique with a sea view from the hill, The SIS Kata Resort at 8.9 · On a budget, Pineapple Guesthouse scores 9.0 at rates from ฿700

faq.q: ❓ How much are Kata & Karon hotels?
faq.a: In this guide, rates start from about ฿700–10,000 per night · At the budget end are Pineapple Guesthouse from ฿700, KK Boutique from ฿900, and Sugar Marina ART / Baan Karonburi from ฿1,400 · Mid-range are Chanalai Romantica ฿1,500, Andaman Cannacia ฿1,800, The Old Phuket ฿2,000 and The SIS Kata ฿2,400 · At the top are Katathani from ฿4,900 and The Shore from ฿10,000 · All are approximate starting rates outside peak season; high season (November–April) rises clearly

faq.q: ❓ How do Kata, Kata Noi and Karon differ, and which zone should I pick?
faq.a: The three beaches sit side by side on Phuket's west coast · Karon Beach is the longest and widest, white sand with people spread out — good for families and anyone who wants space (Sugar Marina ART, Baan Karonburi, Pineapple, The Old Phuket, KK) · Kata Beach is smaller and a touch livelier, with a walkable restaurant strip (Chanalai Romantica, plus The SIS Kata and Andaman Cannacia on the hill above) · Kata Noi is the smallest, quietest cove, tucked behind a headland (Katathani, The Shore) · Want a lively strip? Choose Kata. Want the quietest? Choose Kata Noi. Want a wide beach for swimming with kids? Choose Karon

faq.q: ❓ Which Kata & Karon hotel is best for families?
faq.a: The most family-focused is Katathani Phuket Beach Resort ฿4,900 — a 5-star on Kata Noi Beach with 6 pools and the Aqua Jungle water park, fully family-friendly · On a lighter budget, look at Sugar Marina ART ฿1,400 with a free Kids Club, a kids' pool, and a ~3-minute walk to Karon Beach · Or Baan Karonburi ฿1,400 with a Family Jacuzzi room and a lagoon pool · Note that The Shore and Chanalai Romantica are adults-only, so families with young kids should skip those

faq.q: ❓ Which Kata & Karon hotel is best for couples / adults only?
faq.a: Three stays lean clearly grown-up · The Shore at Katathani ฿10,000 — adults-only pool villas, a private pool in every villa, 9.3, for honeymoons · Chanalai Romantica Resort ฿1,500 — an adults-only boutique in central Kata with Pool Access rooms, 8.7 on a light budget · and The SIS Kata Resort ฿2,400 — a hillside design boutique whose SIS Over The Sea rooms have a twin jacuzzi with a sea view, ideal for couples who care about design and the view

faq.q: ❓ How far ahead should I book, and how do I get there?
faq.a: In Phuket's high season (November–April), book 1–2 months ahead, especially small, high-scoring stays like Chanalai Romantica (65 rooms) and Pineapple, which fill first; in low season 1–2 weeks is enough and rates drop a lot · Getting there: about 45 minutes–1 hour by road from Phuket Airport, by metered taxi, hotel transfer, or Grab · Patong is about 20–30 minutes over the hill · Every platform offers free cancellation, so lock in a rate like that if your plans aren't firm, then compare Agoda / Booking / Trip.com for the best price
